$comment: VAPP-260 (Engine E0, epic VAPP-259, docs/spec/apps.md §13.1, §14): THE ENGINE'S OUTBOX IS O1's, NOT A COPY. The entry, the writes, the overlay, the replay, FIFO order, the outcomes, the prune and the pending label are `packages/domain-contract/fixtures/app-records.json` `outbox` (VAPP-235) exactly as written (`$ref`; the TS reference re-exports `@exp/domain-contract/app-records` `outbox*`, the Rust Engine replays the referenced section). What the Engine adds is WHEN it applies (`modeCases`, `outboxMode`): a host with a `sync` provider (providers.json: Exponential's SyncedRecordStore, Spezl's P2P space) queues every app write as an entry and flushes on lifecycle.json's `flush` effects; a host WITHOUT one (`local` identity, a SqliteRecordStore: the softcoded app, eDE Local desktops, exported apps) has no outbox: a write applies to the store at once, in one transaction per call (a batch stays all or nothing), the store's own `writeId` dedupe still applies, and the pending label never shows. The record store is the authority in local mode; there is nothing to reconcile.
